title: The Clean Drop
author: August Ravensworth
blurb: Vesper Delacroix, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
